---
title: "Research"
---

My research focuses on shock waves and compressible flows.

## Research Topics

### Shock Wave Attenuation

Investigating the modulation and attenuation of shock waves through interactions with:

- **Flows:** three-dimensional jets and uniform flows aligned with the direction of shock propagation
- **Structures:** porous media and orifices

### Shock-Turbulence Interaction

Understanding how shock waves interact with turbulent flows through numerical simulations and experiments.

### Shock-Wave/Boundary-Layer Interaction

Exploring the physics and control of shock-wave/boundary-layer interactions in the presence of wall roughness.
